submitted.rationale: Index 3 (Sb 0.353) had the highest EQE measured, at 0.0342%. EQE rises from index 0 (0.0077%) to index 3, then falls at index 4 (0.021%) and much further at index 8 (0.00086%). XRD shows the same Pb-rich phase across indices 0, 3 and 5, with peaks shifting steadily. Index 5 also shows a small new peak at Q=3.22, the first sign of a second phase. Index 8 is a different phase. The EQE maximum is inside the single-phase region near Sb≈0.35.

rejected.reason: EQE falls steeply with Sb above 0.35 and a phase change occurs; GP suggestion there was driven only by prior variance, not data.
